user.title: Modbus One-Way Control
user.description:
**Add this integration once per USB device.** Enter that USB device's path and baud rate (the display name is optional, useful to tell identical adapters apart).

Switches (`channels`) and buttons (`buttons`) go in /homeassistant/configuration.yaml under modbus_oneway_control:. Use `devices` to group entries per adapter. Each entry becomes one entity.

error.invalid_device: Please enter a valid USB device path.

abort.already_configured: This USB device is already configured.
